name: Animated Data Table
description: Sortable, filterable, selectable table: rows glide to their new order, filtered rows fade out, the sort arrow flips and a bulk-action bar springs up on selection.
a11y: Real <table> with caption, scope=col and aria-sort; checkboxes labelled per row; bulk bar is role=status. Reduced motion: no row movement.
perf: layout="position" on rows only (no size animation); memoised filtering/sorting.
prompt: Build an animated data table with Motion: a semantic table whose tbody rows are motion.tr with layout="position" inside AnimatePresence. Header buttons cycle sort asc → desc → none (aria-sort) with a rotating arrow. A filter input narrows rows. Row checkboxes + select-all; when any are selected, a pill bar springs up from the bottom with the count and Clear.

name: Date Picker
description: Popover calendar that springs open from its field: months slide in the direction you navigate, the selection circle glides between days and the full ARIA grid keyboard model works.
a11y: Button with aria-haspopup=dialog; grid of gridcells with roving tabindex; Arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter, Esc. Locale-aware labels via Intl. Reduced motion: fades only.
perf: 42 day buttons per month; only the visible month mounts.
prompt: Build an animated date picker with Motion: a trigger button opens a popover (scale .96 → 1, snappy spring). Header month label and the 6×7 day grid are keyed by month inside AnimatePresence popLayout with direction-aware x slide. The selected day has a layoutId circle (bouncy). Implement roving tabindex and the WAI-ARIA date grid keys. Use Intl.DateTimeFormat for labels.

name: Radio Cards
description: Selectable option cards built on native radio inputs; a highlight ring glides between cards with shared layout and the dot springs in.
a11y: Native radios (sr-only) inside labels inside a fieldset/legend, so arrow keys and forms work; focus ring via :has(:focus-visible). Reduced motion: instant.
perf: One layoutId element moves between cards.
prompt: Build radio cards: a fieldset with legend; each option is a label wrapping an sr-only native radio, a custom dot (inner circle springs scale 0→1), icon, title/description and an aside (price). The selected card renders a motion.span with a shared layoutId (ring + tinted background) so it glides between cards.

name: Animated Pagination
description: Pagination where the active pill slides between pages, numbers shuffle in and out as the window moves, and arrows nudge in their direction on press.
a11y: nav landmark, aria-current=page, labelled buttons, ellipses hidden from AT. Reduced motion: instant.
perf: popLayout list with a single layoutId pill.
prompt: Build animated pagination with Motion: compute [1, …, p−s..p+s, …, total]; render as motion.li with layout="position" inside AnimatePresence popLayout (scale/opacity in/out). The current page has a layoutId pill. Prev/next arrows nudge x on tap and disable at the ends.

name: Number Input Stepper
description: A stepper whose digits roll in the direction of change, buttons auto-repeat (accelerating) while held, and the field shakes at its limits.
a11y: ARIA spinbutton with valuenow/min/max/valuetext; Arrow Up/Down, Home/End. Reduced motion: fade instead of roll, no shake.
perf: Single span swap per change; hold-repeat via setTimeout accelerating to 50 ms.
prompt: Build a number stepper with Motion: − and + buttons around a spinbutton. The value is keyed in AnimatePresence popLayout with direction-aware variants (enter from y=18·dir, exit to −18·dir). Holding a button repeats with delay ×0.8 down to 50 ms. Hitting min/max shakes the field (x keyframes). Keyboard: arrows, Home, End.

name: Range Slider with Histogram
description: Dual-thumb range slider over a live histogram: bars inside the range light up, the active thumb grows with a value bubble, and thumbs can't cross.
a11y: Each thumb is a full ARIA slider (arrows, PageUp/Down, Home/End) with value text; pointer capture for dragging; histogram aria-hidden. Reduced motion: no scale or colour tweens.
perf: Bars tween colour/scale only when their in-range state flips.
prompt: Build a dual-thumb range slider: a track with a filled segment between thumbs; pointerdown picks the nearest thumb, captures the pointer and snaps values to step without crossing. Each thumb is role=slider with keyboard support and a value bubble while active (spring scale). Optional histogram bars above the track animate colour/scaleY when inside the range.

name: Flip Carousel
description: A carousel where DOM order is the truth: next/prev rotates the array and GSAP Flip animates every card from its old box to its new one — the centre slot is bigger, so cards grow as they pass through.
a11y: Arrow keys on the focused region, labelled buttons, aria-live title; non-centre cards aria-hidden. Reduced motion: instant re-order.
perf: Flip.getState before the React update, Flip.from in a layout effect after — no manual measuring.
prompt: Build a Flip carousel: state is an order array; on next/prev call Flip.getState(track.children) then rotate the array; in a useGSAP layout effect keyed on order run Flip.from(state, { duration .7, ease power3.inOut, nested: true }). Size classes come from distance to the centre slot (big centre, smaller neighbours, faded ends).

name: Shader on Scroll
description: A full-screen fragment shader (raw WebGL) whose uniforms are scrubbed by ScrollTrigger: scrolling twists and zooms an fbm noise field and crossfades the palette panel by panel.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Shader on scroll
a11y: Canvas aria-hidden; text panels are real HTML. Reduced motion: time stops, scroll still changes the palette. CSS gradient fallback without WebGL.
perf: One fullscreen triangle; DPR capped at 1.5; rAF pauses off-screen; context released on unmount.
prompt: Build a scroll-driven shader section: a sticky canvas with a raw WebGL fullscreen triangle running an fbm domain-warp fragment shader (uniforms uTime, uProgress, uA, uB). A ScrollTrigger (scrub) tweens a progress object; progress rotates/zooms the noise domain and picks/lerps palette pairs per panel. Render with rAF only while visible.

name: Text Replace
description: Animated text replacement with GSAP's TextPlugin: each phrase is rewritten into the next, by character or by word, with a highlight sweeping behind it.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Animate text replacement
a11y: The text node is aria-live=polite; reduced motion swaps phrases with a fade.
perf: One repeating timeline; TextPlugin edits a single text node.
prompt: Build a TextPlugin headline: a repeating GSAP timeline that, for each phrase, sweeps a highlight bar in (scaleX 0→1 from the left), tweens the span with text: { value: next, delimiter: mode === 'word' ? ' ' : '' }, then sweeps the bar out to the right. Reduced motion: fade out, set text, fade in.

name: ScrollTo Table of Contents
description: Docs-style table of contents: links glide the scroller to each section with ScrollToPlugin (eased, interruptible) while ScrollTriggers track the active section and a bar slides beside it.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — ScrollTo / scroll waypoints
a11y: Real anchor links with aria-current=location; sections are focusable regions and receive focus after the jump. Reduced motion: instant jump.
perf: ScrollTo autoKill hands control back as soon as the user scrolls.
prompt: Build a table of contents with GSAP ScrollToPlugin: clicking a link tweens the scroller with scrollTo: { y: section, offsetY: 16, autoKill: true } (power3.inOut, 1 s) and focuses the section. One ScrollTrigger per section (start/end at 40%) sets the active index; an indicator bar tweens to the active link's offsetTop/height.

name: Auto-Height Accordion
description: Accordion with one paused GSAP timeline per panel tweening to height:auto, fading the content and turning the chevron; toggling plays or reverses, so fast clicks turn around mid-flight.
inspiration: GSAP Demo Hub — Animate auto height / toggle direction
a11y: Buttons with aria-expanded/aria-controls; panels are labelled regions and inert while closed. Reduced motion: zero durations.
perf: Timelines built once; GSAP measures the auto height.
prompt: Build an accordion with GSAP: per panel, a paused timeline fromTo height 0 → 'auto', fade/lift the inner content, rotate the chevron 180°. Toggle = tl.play() or tl.reverse(), so interrupted toggles reverse smoothly. Single-open mode reverses the others. Panels inert when closed.

name: Keyframes Loader
description: A loader choreographed entirely with GSAP percentage keyframes: four blocks hop, squash on landing, travel around a square and spin, staggered in time.
a11y: role=status with a label and sr-only text. Reduced motion: gentle opacity pulse.
perf: One tween with keyframes + stagger; transforms only.
prompt: Build a GSAP keyframes loader: four absolutely positioned blocks; one gsap.to(blocks, { keyframes: { '0%':…, '15%': hop with stretch, '30%': land with squash, '55%', '70%', '85%': travel around a square with rotation, easeEach: 'power2.inOut' }, duration 2.4, stagger: { each .6, repeat: -1 } }). Reduced motion: yoyo opacity.
